pages.lines:
Camping Rates​
Nightly Rate $50-55​
All campsites have both 30 and 50 amp services, water, sewer, wifi and cable tv.
All rates are based on (1) camping unit and up to (2) adults (2) children and (2) vehicles per campsite.
Weekly Rate $325
For monthly site availability and pricing please contact the office at (336) 263-6974 or submit a reservation request on our contact page, any questions or notes you may have can be added to the message field at the bottom of the form.
Pet Fees $1 per day

pages.lines:
Tent Sites
1-Tent Site--Maximum 4 people.  $38.00/night.
1-Tent Site--Maximum 5 people.  $44.00/night.
2-Tent Site--Maximum 6 people.  $49.00/night.
2-Tent Site--Maximum 8 people.  $54.00/night.
Each site has specific tent size restrictions, which can be found HERE. Make sure that your tent will fit within the sites limitations.
Sites
1 Tent per site--1 small to large tent, maximum of 6 people.  Up to 4 people $45.00/night.  For 5th & 6th persons, add $5 per person/ per night.
RV &
Trailer Sites
Single Sites --1 trailer or RV, maximum of 6 people.  Up to 4 people $45.00/night.  For 5th & 6th persons, add $5 per person/ per night. No tents (other than dining canopy) on RV/Trailer sites.
The Elf

$49.00/night.   Click here for more info.

Enclosed Permanent Camping Shelter--maximum of 2 people.
$59.00/night.  Click here for more info.
Check-in Times:
ALL MEMBERS of your party must arrive within the check-in time window.
Late arrivals may be turned away or charged a late arrival fee of $50 in order for us to reopen the office.
For March 14-October 11, the check-in time will be from 2-7pm.
